title: Penthouse on the Park | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning newly renovated home in Seaside, Florida, offers a luxurious escape nestled alongside the charming Ruskin Park. The entire second floor has been transformed, now boasting two king master suites with private baths, a serene queen bedroom with its own bath, and a custom bunk room designed to sleep up to five kids in comfort. One of the king master suites opens to a private balcony with seating, the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee or a glass of wine while taking in the park views. Every bedroom on this floor is outfitted with custom-built closets and luxury Peacock Alley linens, offering an unparalleled experience of comfort and elegance. The spacious rear balcony offers another spot to relax with stunning views of the town and treetops. On the third floor, you'll find another king master suite with a recently renovated bath featuring dual vanities, a glass-enclosed shower, and a soaking tub. This floor is home to the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area, which exudes sophistication with all-new stainless steel appliances, designer furnishings, and multiple dining spaces. The true highlight of the home is the spiral staircase leading to the rooftop terrace, where guests can enjoy a 360-degree panoramic view of the Gulf of Mexico and the picturesque town of Seaside. With added bonuses like an elevator, a washer/dryer, and ample outdoor seating across multiple balconies, this property offers an exquisite setting for unforgettable vacations.
